name: After That Night
source:
This is a story about a young boy who lost his parent. You are now on your own, and not only that but you also have to take care of your little sister. Join him on his adventure to uncover the truth about his parents' death and seek justice for them. The road is long and rough. Be careful and rational in your actions. Every action has consequences.

[From Patreon]
